searches.reason: Develop a controlled intervention suite that separates item identity, recency, repetition and positional effects. Seek paired fixed-target tests with matched intervention strength, position-preserving controls and simple reference models. This would help distinguish useful history dependence from sensitivity caused by padding or position shifts; perturbation effects alone cannot establish user preferences.

searches.reason: Translate qualitative feedback into auditable failure cases using only histories, titles, descriptions and timestamps. Seek methods that distinguish specific task fit, explicit compatibility requirements and possible redundancy while abstaining when evidence is insufficient. Validate these proxies against explicit feedback from the twenty-user panel, reporting unknown cases separately and avoiding inferred ownership or latent simulator traits.

searches.reason: Build a validation framework for whether diagnostics identify actionable model weaknesses. Compare two-candidate margins with fixed multi-negative and full-catalog training-prefix probes, stratified by training popularity and history length. Across a small set of controlled component ablations, test whether diagnostic changes predict category-level validation HR@10 changes, using paired uncertainty estimates and accounting for repeated validation selection within the GPU budget.
